data.exact_reserve_text:
The estimate for claims at the beginning of the year as compared with net payments and provisions at the end of the year in respect of prior years' claims are as follows:

Marine, aviation and transport 22.4 1.0
Fire and other damage to property 25.9 2.1
Third party liability (8.8) 0.3
Miscellaneous (2.2) 0.0

Favourable movement in technical provisions 37.3 3.4

The movement in estimate of the prior year is driven mainly by favourable loss experience and incurred claims forms a 7% (2019: 1%) component of the 2020 loss ratio of 53% (2019: 58%).
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1225 reported a favourable prior year development totalling GBP 37.3m (a release), driven mainly by favourable loss experience. The release was concentrated in Marine, aviation and transport and Fire and other damage to property, partially offset by adverse movements in Third party liability and Miscellaneous.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in estimate of the prior year is driven mainly by favourable loss experience

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure used is the 'Favourable movement in technical provisions 37.3' from the Prior years' claims estimate note. The note appears to present net payments and provisions context and may be a net (after reinsurance) presentation; the report does not present an explicit labelled GROSS prior-year movement elsewhere. The gross claims development triangle is present and could be used as an alternative check, but the direct prior-years note was used as primary. Where LOB mapping was ambiguous ("Miscellaneous"), it was mapped to 'Reinsurance - Specialty' with lower confidence.
